judgmentCaveat: Semantic annotations are model judgments, not independent factual verification; extraction completeness is model-reported.
citationInventoryNote: Answer citations are a syntactic inventory of Markdown links, Obsidian wiki links, bracketed wiki paths, and bracketed checkpoint/source paths; spans use Unicode code points. Only exact local targets supplied to that answer arm resolve. This does not detect uncited natural-language references, aliases/encoded paths, or whether a resolved target supports the answer. No citations is an explicit zero count. Missing judge evidence is separate as unresolvedJudgeEvidenceClaims.

maintenance.judgmentCaveat: Maintenance quality labels are model judgments; page hashes and cited spans are mechanically checked.

efficiency.note: Actual provider-reported usage only; missing usage makes category totals null. Correct-only uses evaluator correct===true; completions and judging remain separate. Pricing is unavailable. Shared preparation is not treated as free for sources-only.
